verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own docs say it securely stores physical mail and lets users forward physical items wherever needed, and it can send checks directly to the user's bank. That is a thin, glancing basis for per-item physical disposal choices. Missing for 10: documented storage windows/retention periods, on-request shredding, shred confirmation, and a full set of per-item disposal options (shred/recycle/forward/hold), plus any independent or hands-on corroboration.
